context.why: US-1 is delivered: MVP_COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS and declared_documents() exist, and migrate creates declared documents. This story fixes a declared document's slug from the start: Document.save(), DocumentQuerySet.update() (and so bulk_update) and the admin refuse a change while the stored slug is declared, with a new DeclaredDocumentError. Name, kind and enforcement stay editable. A document whose declaration is removed follows the ordinary rule again.

conventions: declared_documents() in models.py returns getattr(settings, 'MVP_COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS', {}), read at the point of use like acceptances_survive_account_removal()
Repo standards that reviews have missed before: no leading-underscore names anywhere; line length 88; no compatibility aliases; no test of text content or wording; no test of layout or appearance
A mechanism an experienced Django developer would recognise beats a clever one: no dataclass, registry or settings object
Every user-facing string is wrapped for translation and none says 'compliant', 'compliance' or names a regulation
Text for docs is written for an outside contributor: plain words, no mention of agents, stages or tooling
The declared check runs in Document.save() and DocumentQuerySet.update() BEFORE the existing published check, reading the STORED slug (not the new value) against declared_documents()

DocumentAdmin.get_readonly_fields(): change the existing condition to 'published or declared' so 'slug' is appended once (design review ARCH-001). get_prepopulated_fields() already drops the prepopulation when slug is read-only
DeclaredDocumentError goes in mvp_compliance/exceptions.py beside the others, not a ValidationError subclass (ADR 0003); tests/test_exceptions.py covers it as it covers the others

Admin test: the change form of a declared document with no version renders no slug input (find by the field name), and POSTing a different slug leaves it unchanged; an undeclared document with no version still has the input

Docs: docs/models.md 'When the slug is fixed' covers the declared case, DeclaredDocumentError, and names the routes that refuse (save, update, bulk_update, the admin) and those that do not (bulk_create with update_conflicts, _base_manager, a data migration's historical model). ADR 0019's Decision paragraph is edited to read as the current rule, with no strikethrough or dated note. CONTEXT.md Slug entry. CHANGELOG entry extended
